title: OpenAI taps Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for extra Azure AI capacity

sources.quote: Oracle, Microsoft, and OpenAl are partnering to extend the Microsoft Azure Al platform to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) to provide additional capacity for OpenAl.

explain: OpenAI's first deal to use Oracle's cloud: Oracle supplied extra AI computing that plugged into Microsoft's Azure platform. No amount was given; it was the start of a relationship that grew into the much larger Stargate contracts.
